subject: Re: LedgerAI - GCP private offer: consumption reshuffle & co-sell actions
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver@ledgerai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-marketplace-sales@google.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LedgerAI private offer — request to reshuffle consumption & escrow timing

Jonas,

Thanks for the call last week. Procurement has reviewed the private offer and the proposed drawdown schedule is tighter than our Q3 forecast. We need to push a portion of the committed credits later in the quarter and move 150k USD from Month 1 into Month 3 to match our expected on-prem ramp.

Attached is the PO (LedgerAI_PO_Q2.pdf) with the current GCP SKU list. Two asks:
- Can Redwood accept a reprofile (move $150k from June -> August) and reflect that in the private offer invoice schedule?
- Can you confirm co-sell crediting will still apply if we stagger redemptions? We need the GCP sales crediting for our internal procurement approval.

We'd like to finalize a mutual action plan by next Thursday (6/14).

Best,
Oliver Hayes
Head of Procurement
LedgerAI

[Attachment: LedgerAI_PO_Q2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver@ledgerai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-marketplace-sales@google.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerAI private offer — request to reshuffle consumption & escrow timing

Oliver — thanks for the note and PO. I looped in Marissa (co-sell lead) and Ben (finance/marketplace ops) so we can align on both the contract and SKU mapping.

Short answer: we can support a one-time reprofile of committed drawdown across the quarter, subject to GCP Marketplace escrow constraints. Proposed approach (attached: consumption_reshuffle_v1.xlsx):
1) Move $150k from Period-1 -> Period-3 and keep total commitment unchanged.
2) Create a short MOU amendment to the private offer that documents the month-level re-profile and is countersigned by LedgerAI procurement.
3) GCP co-sell crediting: we will request a crediting exception with our Marketplace PM and provide the case details to GCP to preserve co-sell attribution (no guarantee until GCP approves).

Can Ben confirm whether the SKU remap below is feasible from invoicing side? Marissa, once GCP confirms crediting, can you own the co-sell communication to the LedgerAI account team so they register the opportunity correctly?

Next steps:
- Ben to confirm invoice/sku feasibility (today EOD)
- Jonas to draft MOU amendment and send for signature (tomorrow)
- Marissa to engage GCP Marketplace on crediting (tomorrow)

If that timeline works, we'll aim for a signed amendment by 6/14.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: consumption_reshuffle_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Oliver Hayes <oliver@ledgerai.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerAI private offer — request to reshuffle consumption & escrow timing

Quick note on the invoice mapping and SKU constraints.

- We can remap the $150k across months but GCP Marketplace will require the same aggregate SKU consumption over the offer lifetime; we cannot change SKU unit pricing mid-offer without a formal amendment and GCP PM sign-off.
- Operationally, best path is to keep original SKU buckets but change the allocation schedule in the private-offer metadata. I attached a CSV sketch of a co-sell matrix that aligns SKUs to ledger usage patterns.

Action items for us:
- I will prepare the SKU mapping file for the Marketplace team and flag any SKU mismatches (by EOD Wednesday).
- Jonas — for the MOU language, call out: (a) the moved amount, (b) date ranges affected, (c) that co-sell crediting is subject to GCP approval but we will submit the request on LedgerAI's behalf.

Ben
Ben Carter
Manager, Marketplace Programs
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: MOU_co-sell_matrix.csv (text/csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver@ledgerai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-marketplace-sales@google.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerAI private offer — request to reshuffle consumption & escrow timing

Oliver — appreciate the fast turnaround from your team. Per our internal review and Ben's notes, here's the mutual action plan and requested artifacts to get this over the finish line: 

1) Redwood will prepare and send an MOU amendment documenting the month-level reprofile (Jonas to send tomorrow).
2) LedgerAI to countersign and return PO update (procurement) — Oliver, can you confirm who will sign?
3) Redwood will submit a co-sell crediting request to GCP with the attached SKU mapping and the MOU. GCP typically needs 3 business days to adjudicate; we'll keep LedgerAI and the account team updated.
4) DocuSign: once countersigned, we'll route the MOU through DocuSign. Link (provisional): https://www.docusign.com/--/envelope/ABC123-ledgerai-sign

Target dates:
- Ben: SKU mapping to GCP by 6/11 EOD
- Jonas: MOU draft by 6/11 noon
- Oliver: countersigned PO/MOU by 6/14

If GCP denies crediting, we will escalate and propose a partial crediting fallback (split attribution) so LedgerAI's procurement approval doesn't stall.

Thanks all — feel free to call if you want to run through the MOU language live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Partner GTM (Co-sell)
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: none]
